changelog: SNMP settings are practical to copy into an NMS
Administrators now see the configured v2c/trap communities and SNMPv3 USM keys as plain text in the SNMP editor.
Read-only viewer/operator sessions continue to receive masked values, and unrelated credentials remain protected.
changelog_es: SNMP communities and SNMPv3 USM keys are visible as plain text in the SNMP editor for administrators, while read-only viewer/operator projections remain masked.
SNMP Save now round-trips the visible community/key values explicitly and applies version/community changes to the embedded agent immediately.
Settings security projection tests, SNMP standard tests, invariants and browser save/wire validation.
